import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    0: {"processing_time": 89, "due_date": 549, "weight": 5},
    1: {"processing_time": 51, "due_date": 398, "weight": 2},
    2: {"processing_time": 81, "due_date": 479, "weight": 7},
    3: {"processing_time": 67, "due_date": 100, "weight": 5},
    4: {"processing_time": 38, "due_date": 403, "weight": 10},
    5: {"processing_time": 78, "due_date": 497, "weight": 9},

    7: {"processing_time": 52, "due_date": 429, "weight": 1},
    8: {"processing_time": 71, "due_date": 533, "weight": 5},
    9: {"processing_time": 5, "due_date": 348, "weight": 4},
    10: {"processing_time": 35, "due_date": 340, "weight": 9},
    11: {"processing_time": 3, "due_date": 412, "weight": 9},
    12: {"processing_time": 23, "due_date": 369, "weight": 5},
    13: {"processing_time": 96, "due_date": 256, "weight": 8},
    14: {"processing_time": 97, "due_date": 472, "weight": 7},
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Number of jobs
n = len(jobs)

# Add variables
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion times
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # Sequencing variables

# Add constraints
# Each job must be scheduled exactly once
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="one_job_once")

# Each position in the sequence must be filled by exactly one job
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in range(n)) == 1 for j in range(n)), name="one_position_once")

# Calculate completion times based on sequence
model.addConstrs(
    (C[j] >= gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n)) +
     (C[j-1] if j > 0 else 0) for j in range(n)), name="completion_times"
)

# Calculate tardiness
model.addConstrs((T[i] >= C[i] - jobs[i]["due_date"] for i in range(n)), name="tardiness")

# Objective: Minimize weighted sum of tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["weight"] * T[i] for i in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = [None] * n
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if x[i, j].X > 0.5:
            sequence[j] = i

# Calculate objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output result
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(result)
